method: vertical line through each live player position against every MeshShape triangle placed by a ShadowRigidBody or by an Entity/EntityGroup RigidBody component of the world archive (shapes from the archive and its _assets companions; primitives not decoded); support = highest surface at or below player z + step
live_point_rule: hop scan 'at' rows, and live-state samples whose z changed by at most 5 mm over three consecutive samples; deduplicated on 0.25 m xy / 0.05 m z
on_foot_rule: dominant clip name starts xx_Nav_ or acu_nav_ and has no WallBrace, or the point is a hop-scan settled position
